material.head: Wave 2 in its buy zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from May 4 to Aug 13 (+41%, wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+1.7% to −4.3%), with the 50-day average and the 200-day average in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−12%); a close over the wave-1 high (+24%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the October breakout level, the average price paid since the Aug 13 high and the 50-day average, where 6 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a higher low in price (the week of Sep 28) against a lower low in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
material.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

material.head: Next support −2.5% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −2.5% below (0.8 ATR), where 6 levels (3 kinds) meet: the April breakout level, the most-traded price of six months and the 50% retracement of the Oct 1–Oct 28 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
